probes.question: True or false: 0.999... (repeating forever) is exactly equal to 1.

image.alt: A horizontal number line with dots stepping ever closer to the final mark, which is circled in orange, with a dotted arc above.

body.claim: The number 0.999... with the 9s going on forever is exactly equal to 1, not just very close.
body.why: One way to see it: 1/3 is 0.333..., and three times that is 0.999..., but three times 1/3 is also 1. Another: there is no number between 0.999... and 1, so they can't be different numbers.
